audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Ambient algebraic boundary on exceptional divisor equals product boundaries with oversized centers allowed; Global algebraic Gram morphism on projectivized parabolic endomorphisms and unrestricted monoid quotient; Closed exceptional locus minus strict Det equals product of unblown determinant complements; closed-locus intersection isolates open e(P)
limitations: F1 — Counterevidence: Polytope product and pointedness are not refuted. Pointedness follows because q(a)=-q(b) implies a+b in face C∩W and hence a,b∈W.
F2 — Counterevidence: Actual X(P) uses invertible real matrices. Correct restricted(A.24) and positive block(A.32) support intended real construction; no topological counterexample claimed.
F3 — Counterevidence: Open strata removing all additional exceptional divisors admit intended product description; paper already distinguishes closed/open S_I in(A.17)/(A.23).
F4 — Counterevidence: Comparison morphism follows from inclusion of arrangements via Proposition5.2(ii); core construction independent.
F5 — Counterevidence: For PSD Q=B^TB, Q(v,v)=0 implies Bv=0→Qv=0. Intersection identity with positive sigma suffices.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
